description: This file defines data structures and an interface related to custom actions, including control panel buttons, device states, and configuration providers for a project likely related to Android or embedded systems. It also declares a component for dependency injection.

classes.name: CustomActionConfigProvider
classes.description: An interface class providing access to custom shell actions, action servers, and device state actions.

methods.name: CustomShellActions
methods.description: Returns a list of custom shell action configurations, optionally filtered by an identifier.

methods.name: CustomActionServers
methods.description: Returns a list of custom action server configurations, optionally filtered by an identifier.

methods.name: CustomDeviceStateActions
methods.description: Returns a list of custom device state action configurations, optionally filtered by an identifier.
